text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning
many races alongside Nice Nature...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Say... Trainer-san.
Do ya have a quick moment right now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...You know that 'Hot Springs Vacation Ticket' you won before?
What... happened to it?"

She seems to be talking about the grand prize we won together
at the lottery before. While I do consider myself just "holding onto it"
for her...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then, um, after all...
Could I go too, please?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Look, I gave it some thought, and wouldn't it be a total waste if I won tickets and didn't even go?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I like hot springs, yes, I really love them!
I was just thinking... it'd be nice to be pampered a bit~."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So... is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hell yeahâwait, no.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All right, then we've got to
coordinate our schedules right away!
choice_data_list: So who are you going with?
So, who are you going with?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: With Trainer, of course! Who else!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...We've arrived.

One thing led to another after that, and
we ended up coming on a hot spring trip together, but...

Nice Nature seems somewhat awkward.
Perhaps it's because I was so caught off guard
by her invitation that I gave a goofy reaction.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aaah... let's see.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I hear the hot springs here have incredible therapeutic benefits.
For now, why don't we go take a quick soak?
In the bath...
After taking a bath, as I was relaxing in the room—
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer, it's me. Can I come in?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
That was a nice bath.
choice_data_list: Were you able to get some good rest?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course!
It gave me some nice, gentle soothing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All that pain built up in Nature-san's
shoulders and lower back just melted right away~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...So, what about you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Of course I got to rest!
Of course I got to rest!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Then it's all good.
I'm glad we came to the hot springs... right?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Don't talk like that, please.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"You could've at least said something like,
'I wanted to come with Nature too.'"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You could have at least said something like,
"I wanted to come with Nature too."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Saying 'Thanks for the invite' makes it sound like
she didn't really care either way.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now it looks like I'm the only one...
...never mind.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I wonder about that~
Your eyes are darting all over the place, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm acting totally unreasonable right now.
So even if you think I'm being annoying, I can't blame you—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder about that~.
choice_data_list: What can I do to make you believe me?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: A trophy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Gimme that floppy trophy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: This is basically a reward trip for working hard, right? So I was kinda hoping for a 'good job' prize or something.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So... make it right here, right now.
You brought a notepad or something, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really?
Then that makes me want you to make it for me even more~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm always the only one showing my weak side.
Don't you think that's a bit unfair?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, I'll be right beside you watching.
Make sure it's a masterpiece that blows Nature-san away, alright?

Afterward, with Nice Nature playfully nudging me,
I made the trophy she wanted and handed it over.
As for the quality... She was laughing, so I called it a win.

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Nice Nature...
